stock.description: Green Fresh Biotechnology Co., Ltd. operates as an investment holding entity with its core business focused on the manufacturing and distribution of hydrocolloid products for the food industry. The company's activities are organized across distinct product lines: Agar-Agar, Carrageenan, Konjac Products, and a range of Blended Products. This firm was established on July 3, 2015, and its main office is situated in Hong Kong.
